# sink_green_soap_bottle — repaired realism QA

Evidence: f0008, f0168, f3684. Calibrations and source images are retained in ../measurements.json and ../evidence/.

- Made the 0.7 mm PET wall explicit before mesh join/export and verified its exported dimensions.
- Corrected PET IOR to 1.57 and made detergent transmissive.

Flattened clear plastic bottle with green liquid and photo label. Neck height inferred from camera ray at assumed bottle centre because transparent depth is invalid. Open flip cap observed. Hidden back and fluid level are approximate; rigid solid collision excludes fluid/deformation simulation. Cap rest is open; q=0 is the observed pose.

Physics: Estimated 0.53 kg detergent plus 0.05 kg PET/cap; liquid level and density uncertain. Mass 0.58 kg, friction 0.3, restitution 0.1. All are estimates, not measured product values. See model.json physics for COM, density and material model.

No manipulation was observed. Joints and ranges remain unverified assumptions. See ../qa_report.json and ../qa_summary.md for measured comparisons and outstanding limitations.

## Round 2

Source-pose grades: silhouette B, proportions A, color_texture B, articulation B, physics B, collision B, instances B. Mean silhouette IoU 0.849.



Remaining: Joint axes/ranges/return forces are estimated; no actuation was observed. B for cap/pump means plausible topology only, not dynamic calibration. Mass, friction and centre of mass are estimates; real product weight unavailable.
